name: walletfollow
description: Research Hyperliquid wallets, markets and copy portfolios with explicit source freshness, costs and coverage.

interface.longDescription: Inspect wallet metrics, positions, retained history, market observations and published copy portfolios. Read-only account reports require the customer's existing permissions. Results preserve source timestamps and missing coverage; this plugin cannot execute trades or request wallet signatures.
defaultPrompt: Compare these wallets' 30-day PnL, costs, source age and history gaps.
Screen ten wallets by 30-day realized PnL and explain the coverage limits.
Summarize a published copy portfolio's weights, exposures and statistics.
